title: This Gecko Drops Its Own Tail on Purpose
lines: This little gecko is about to do something wild.
A cat spots it on the wall, and strikes.
But the gecko drops its own tail. On purpose.
Let's watch that again, in slow motion.
The tail keeps wriggling for minutes, and the cat can't look away.
If it were you, it would be like dropping your arm and leaving it waving on the floor.
And the best part? The tail grows back. Follow for more!
caption:
Geckos can drop their own tail on purpose 🦎 It breaks at a built-in weak point, keeps wriggling for minutes to distract the predator, and the gecko runs away. Then a new tail grows back (with cartilage instead of bone).
